subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails` be suppressed before mutating-tool handling, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible while the issue is narrowed?
rationale: The one-line patch conflicts with existing detail-mode tests and does not decide whether useful exec failure details should be hidden in scheduled or diagnostic contexts.

options.title: Clarify and repair before merge
options.body: Decide the warning contract, then rework the policy ordering and regression tests to match it before merging this PR or a replacement.

options.title: Preserve detail-mode warnings
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec warnings visible and narrow the linked issue to a smaller reproducible leak instead of suppressing all includeDetails cases.

options.title: Accept suppress-all policy
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally choose to hide all exec-like warning payloads, but the PR still needs ordering changes, tests, and real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Clarify and repair before merge
recommendation.body: Decide the warning contract, then rework the policy ordering and regression tests to match it before merging this PR or a replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent history across the warning, mutation, and tool-display surfaces most affected by the policy choice.
